data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 露台打烊后的围裙解扣
data.description: 咖啡馆打烊后的露天阳台，晚霞渐渐化为淡紫色的暮霭。爱衣脱下外衬只穿着咖啡馆无袖围裙内衬，解开腰间系带。晚风吹拂着她乌黑的双马尾，平日爽朗直率的女孩单手撩起耳边碎发，泛红的双颊在柔和天光中透着令人心动的反差娇羞。
data.location: open cafe rooftop terrace overlooking twilight town
data.action: loosening cafe apron strings on balcony at dusk, bare shoulders, black twintails swaying in evening wind, blushing tenderly while looking at viewer
data.lighting: cool violet and rose twilight sky mixed with warm outdoor cafe lights
data.promptProse: Standing on a cafe balcony as twilight settles over the city, Mei Hiuchidani unties her work apron over a sleeveless top. The evening breeze sways her black twintails as she looks back with a flustered, endearing blush.
data.animaCaption: Mei untying her apron on a twilight cafe terrace, blushing as her black twintails flutter.
